name: code-review
title_zh: 双轨并行审代码：一边查规范，一边对需求
tagline_zh: PR 改了一百行，你怕漏了规范又怕跑偏需求？它派两个子代理同时查，报告并排摆，一眼看出哪边欠火候。
tagline_en: PR changed 100 lines—worried about style drift or spec gaps? Two sub-agents check standards & spec in parallel.
desc_en: Review the changes since a fixed point (commit, branch, tag, or merge-base) along two axes: Standards (does the code follow this repo's documented coding standards?) and Spec (does the code match what the originating issue/spec asked for?). Runs both reviews in parallel sub-agents and reports them side by side. Use when the user wants to review a branch, a PR, work-in-progress changes, or asks to
why_zh: 不是先查规范再对需求，而是同时开两条审查线，互不干扰，最后并排呈现，省你一半等待时间。
why_en: Runs standards and spec checks concurrently, not sequentially—halves wait time and avoids blind spots from single-pass review.
limit_zh: 需要仓库有明确的编码规范文档，且每个变更能对应到 issue 或 spec；否则规范轴会空转，spec 轴只能靠猜。
limit_en: Requires documented coding standards and traceable issue/spec per change; otherwise standards axis idles, spec axis guesses. Output is review report.
title_en: Parallel code review: standards & spec, side by side
